svg.font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Left, the zebrafish heart atlas as a loop: one uninjured state, an arrow marked injury, then seven measured timepoints from 6 hours to 28 days post-amputation arranged round a loop that closes back onto uninjured. Each timepoint is a stack of real sections from different hearts. Right, one section simulated by the learned rule, with a gold dot on the loop marking where the simulation has reached.
svg.text: The data: a loop of unpaired snapshots
every timepoint is a stack of sections from different fish
The simulation: one section, twice cut
the same rule, with no clock and no stage label
the gold dot marks where on the loop it has reached
